description: List all projects belonging to an organization.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of project objects (id, slug, name, platform, status, dateCreated); on failure (organization not found), output contains an error message.

description: List issues for a project, optionally filtered by status and level, sorted by last seen descending.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of issue objects; on failure (organization or project not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single issue by its id within an organization.

issue_id.description: The unique id of the issue.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the issue object; on failure (organization or issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the status of an issue to 'resolved', 'ignored', or 'unresolved'.

issue_id.description: The unique id of the issue to update.

status.description: The new status; must be one of 'resolved', 'ignored', or 'unresolved'.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated issue object; on failure (invalid status, or organization/issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the events associated with an issue, sorted by creation date descending.

issue_id.description: The unique id of the issue.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of event objects; on failure (organization or issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: List releases for an organization, optionally filtered by project, sorted by creation date descending.

project.description: Optional project slug to filter releases by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of release objects; on failure (organization not found), output contains an error message.
